title: Superposition and interference
target: Add signed displacements and distinguish interference from lost energy.
criteria: Add wave displacements at the same place and time.
Explain that pulses continue after crossing in a linear medium.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: At one string location and instant, two pulse displacements are +6 mm and −2 mm. What is total displacement in a linear medium?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: At a point, two pulses contribute −3 cm and −5 cm. What is the total displacement?
cpa.guide: Both displacements point downward, so they add to −8 cm.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: Two equal upward crests meet at one location. What is the displacement there during overlap?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: A +4 mm pulse and a −4 mm pulse overlap exactly in a linear medium. Which description is correct at that instant?
options: A permanent knot containing both pulses.
Zero net displacement from destructive interference.
cpa.guide: Displacements cancel locally; that does not imply permanent destruction of both waves.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.

cpa.prompt: Two pulses cross on an ideal linear string. What happens after overlap ends?
options: Both remain stuck at the crossing.
Each continues along its original direction with its original shape.
cpa.guide: Superposition is temporary addition; ideal linear pulses continue through one another.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: A string looks momentarily flat when opposite pulses overlap. What later observation would be consistent with linear superposition?
options: Both pulses become matter traveling together.
The pulses reappear on opposite sides, moving onward.
Only a fixed-end reflection could explain the overlap.
The string remains permanently flat because all energy was destroyed.
cpa.guide: Temporary displacement cancellation is compatible with continued wave motion and energy.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Select a claim supported by the stated evidence and assumptions.
